title: [Audit] Raw signal feed (noise gate applied)
description: The full audit stream with the monitor-ping and bulk-authentication noise removed. This is the firehose you can actually read. body.text is emitted only on Kibana events, so that column is empty on Elasticsearch rows.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, resource.attributes.service.name, attributes.event.action, attributes.event.outcome, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, client.ip, client.geo.country_iso_code, body.text | SORT @timestamp DESC
